label.description: The accessible name of the menu.

x.description: Where the panel's inline-start edge sits, in viewport pixels. A root menu is placed at the pointer or beside its opener; a submenu is placed beside its row by the menu behaviour.

y.description: Where the panel's block-start edge sits, in viewport pixels.

floor.description: The lowest edge this panel and its submenus may reach, in viewport pixels; 0 means the viewport. A menu opened from a rail that abuts a status bar sets it to the rail's bottom, so a tall submenu never runs down over the bar.

open.description: Whether the panel is showing. Follows the platform's toggle event; write it through showPopover() and hidePopover(), not directly.

onKeydown.description: The menu keyboard contract: Arrow keys, Home, End and typeahead move; Enter and Space activate; ArrowRight opens a submenu and ArrowLeft leaves it; Escape closes one level; Tab closes the whole stack.

onToggle.description: Mirrors the platform's toggle event into open, clamps a freshly shown panel into the viewport, and moves focus to the first row.

onPointerOver.description: Opens the submenu of the row under the pointer and closes any sibling's.

onMount.description: Announces that the element has rendered and carries its popover attribute, so a host may show it. A menu is always an auto popover: light dismiss and Escape are the platform's.
